rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “proverbial” means a familiar or stereotypical example.

example.english: He is the proverbial scatterbrain who is always late.
example.traditional: 佢成日遲到，真係典型嘅大頭蝦。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 zan1 hai6 din2 jing4 ge3 daai6 tau4 haa1

rows.note: Use this when “proverbial” specifically stresses that something is widely known or famous rather than typical.

example.english: This cinema used to be a proverbial local landmark.
example.traditional: 呢間戲院以前係區內出名嘅地標。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 hei3 jyun2 ji5 cin4 hai6 keoi1 noi6 ceot1 meng2 ge3 dei6 biu1
